root_cause.text: In the RDMA/mana CQ setup path, `mana_ib_install_cq_cb()` used a `WARN_ON(gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id])` instead of rejecting duplicate CQ table entries, so a user-controlled uAPI could request WQs sharing the same CQ and trigger a kernel warning followed by unsafe state corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces `WARN_ON(gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id]);` with `if (gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id]) return -EINVAL;` and the commit message explicitly says “the user can specify WQs sharing the same CQ as a part of the uAPI and this will trigger the WARN_ON() then go on to corrupt the kernel.”

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch replaces `WARN_ON(gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id]);` with `if (gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id]) return -EINVAL;` and the commit message explicitly says “the user can specify WQs sharing the same CQ as a part of the uAPI and this will trigger the WARN_ON() then go on to corrupt the kernel.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Reject installation of an already-used CQ table entry with -EINVAL instead of only warning, preventing unsupported CQ sharing.
intent_record.what: In mana_ib_install_cq_cb(), the code that previously issued WARN_ON(gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id]) was replaced with an explicit check that returns -EINVAL when gc->cq_table[cq->queue.id] is already populated. The nearby comment was updated to note that sharing a CQ between WQs is not supported.
intent_record.how: At runtime, attempting to install a CQ callback for an already-occupied CQ table slot now fails cleanly with -EINVAL instead of only triggering a warning. This prevents unsupported CQ sharing from proceeding and turns the condition into a normal error path.

grouping_result.intent: Reject installation of an already-used CQ table entry with -EINVAL instead of only warning, preventing unsupported CQ sharing.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause: it replaces a warning-only check with explicit rejection of duplicate CQ table entries, preventing user-controlled CQ sharing and the resulting unsafe state corruption.

candidates.rationale: This statement only warns when the CQ table slot is already occupied, but it does not reject the duplicate installation. That allows unsupported CQ sharing through the uAPI and can leave the CQ table in an unsafe state.

vuln_statements.explanation: This line only emits a warning when the CQ table slot is already occupied, but it does not reject the duplicate CQ installation. In the CQ setup path, that permits user-controlled requests to share the same CQ and can leave the CQ table in an unsafe state, matching the reported root cause.
